name: Rodri

recent_news.headline: Rodri leaves Manchester City and signs for Barcelona until June 2030
facts: Barcelona announced the transfer on 18 Aug 2026 and said Rodri is committed to the club until 30 June 2030; the club player page lists No. 16. The club announcement does not state the fee.
Reported fee: EUR 60m (ESPN) or EUR 76.5m including EUR 16.5m add-ons (NYT via Wikipedia); Wikipedia's City page gives about GBP 65m.
Before the deal, outlets said City insisted Rodri was 'not for sale' (Wikipedia summary of press reports).
recent_news.verification_note: Date and contract verified on club site (fee not disclosed there; fee from ESPN/Wikipedia). 94 days old but explains every current story.

recent_news.headline: Mourinho: Real Madrid made a very good offer, but Rodri hesitated and Madrid dropped out
facts: Real Madrid coach Jose Mourinho said Madrid offered Rodri a very good deal.
Rodri's hesitation led Madrid to drop their pursuit before Barcelona closed the deal.
recent_news.verification_note: Guardian page blocked; Mourinho's remark confirmed on Wikipedia's Rodri page (Mourinho is Real Madrid head coach). Treat as Mourinho's claim, not established fact.

recent_news.headline: Barcelona win 5-0 at Elche with Rodri left out for lack of match rhythm
facts: ESPN says Rodri missed the 5-0 win at Elche because he lacked match rhythm.
He started training with his new teammates on the Monday and was named on the bench against Athletic.
Flick called him 'the perfect player for us, the perfect player for our philosophy'.
recent_news.verification_note: ESPN confirms Elche was the Sunday match (23 Aug, 5-0) and the match-rhythm reason.

recent_news.headline: Rodri debuts for Barcelona as a 62nd-minute sub in 2-0 win over Athletic: 'I am where I want to be'
facts: He replaced Marc Bernal in the 62nd minute at Spotify Camp Nou (59,326 fans) and got a warm ovation.
Rodri said it had been a long summer but he was where he wanted to be (club report).
ESPN quotes Flick: 'He's the perfect player for us' (Flick's words are in ESPN, not the club report); the crowd gave Rodri a warm welcome.
recent_news.verification_note: Match 27 Aug 2026 (Thursday), 2-0 v Athletic, 59,326; 62nd-minute sub for Bernal. Rodri quote from club report, Flick quote from ESPN.

recent_news.headline: Rodri booked at Valencia as Barcelona win 5-0 away
facts: Wikipedia match report lists a yellow card for Rodri in the 47th minute at Mestalla.
Barcelona won 5-0 (Yamal 2, Raphinha, Fermin Lopez, Pedri).
recent_news.verification_note: Wikipedia match events: Valencia 0-5 Barcelona on 6 Sep; yellow cards Cubarsi 45+3, Rodri 47, Fermin 65. Single source (Wikipedia). Gabriel Jesus debut claim removed (not supported).

recent_news.headline: Rodri nominated for the 2026 Ballon d'Or with Yamal and Cubarsi
facts: Barcelona's player page says he was nominated for the Ballon d'Or on 8 Sep 2026, alongside Lamine Yamal and Pau Cubarsi.
He is the 2024 winner.
Nominees list had 30 men.
recent_news.verification_note: 30-nominee count from Wikipedia 2026 Ballon d'Or page.

recent_news.headline: Rodri scores in the 35th minute as Spain beat Czech Republic 3-1 in Oviedo
facts: Goals: Yamal 6', Rodri 35', Merino 89' for Spain; Slama 69' for the Czechs.
Match was Nations League A Group 3, matchday 3, in front of 28,515 at Carlos Tartiere.
Wikipedia lists him at 74 caps and 5 Spain goals as of 6 Oct 2026.
recent_news.verification_note: UEFA match page (uefa.com/uefanationsleague/match/2047971/) is the cited report but its content did not load.

recent_news.headline: Rodri heads in his first Barcelona goal in a 5-2 win at Real Betis
facts: Header from a corner, assisted by Fermin Lopez, 41st minute.
It came 51 days after his 27 Aug debut.
Other scorers: Yamal, Gabriel Jesus, Dani Olmo, Eric Garcia.
recent_news.verification_note: Two Wikipedia pages agree (Barcelona season, Rodri); no club report found. Yamal's Betis strike was Liga Goal of the Month for October (fcbarcelona.com 9 Nov).

recent_news.headline: Barcelona lose El Clasico 1-2 at home to Real Madrid
facts: Raphinha (61') scored for Barcelona; Mbappe scored twice for Real Madrid (41', 87'); attendance 62,055.
It was Barcelona's first league defeat of the season and second straight defeat after a 4-2 loss at PSG in the Champions League on 20 Oct.
Whether Rodri played is NOT confirmed by any source read.
recent_news.verification_note: Team story only; do not attribute the result to Rodri.

recent_news.headline: Rodri finishes 4th in the Ballon d'Or; Harry Kane wins
facts: Ceremony at the London Palladium on 26 Oct 2026; Kane won with 1,055 points, Mbappe 2nd, Yamal 3rd.
Rodri, the 2024 winner, finished 4th with 726 points, ahead of Messi (612) and Haaland (378).
Rodri's 4th place and the Kane win are on Wikipedia's 2026 Ballon d'Or page (Messi 5th with 612, Haaland 8th with 378).
recent_news.verification_note: Ceremony, winner, Rodri 4th with 726, 30 nominees all confirmed on Wikipedia 2026 Ballon d'Or page. ESPN/Reuters confirmation not checked.

recent_news.headline: Barcelona report a right hamstring injury; Rodri to miss Atletico game
facts: Club player page says Barcelona reported the right hamstring injury on 4 Nov 2026 and that he would miss the Atletico Madrid match.
No return date is given on that page.
In 2025-26 at City he also missed two spells with hamstring and groin injuries.
recent_news.verification_note: SENSITIVE: injury. News only, never a joke. Current fitness as of 20 Nov is unknown.

recent_news.headline: Barcelona win 2-1 at Atletico with Bernal in midfield and go five points clear
facts: Fermin Lopez scored twice (45+', 67') after Giuliano Simeone's 10th-minute opener; Barcelona top La Liga five points ahead of Atletico.
Club report says Flick made one change from the Aston Villa side, with Marc Bernal replacing 'the injured Rodr...' (text cut off in the fetch).
Wikipedia La Liga table: Barcelona 33 pts, Real Madrid 30, Atletico 28 after 12 games.
recent_news.verification_note: Injury link, so SENSITIVE. Club report names the injured 'Rodr...' replaced by Bernal; almost certainly Rodri given the 4 Nov report. Fermin's second goal 67' (club) / 66' (Wikipedia).

recent_news.headline: Rodri named in the 2026 FIFPRO World XI with Yamal and Cubarsi
facts: Voted by 19,806 professional players.
Barcelona list his figures as 41 appearances (33 for Manchester City, 8 at the World Cup) and two goals, both for City.
He won the World Cup Best Player award with Spain.

recent_news.headline: ESPN's November top-10 players list leaves Rodri out; Yamal is No. 1
facts: List: 1 Yamal, 2 Bellingham, 3 Olise, 4 Raphinha, 5 Kane, 6 Mbappe, 7 Rice, 8 Haaland, 9 Pedri, 10 Vitinha.
Rodri appears only in the intro: author Ryan O'Hanlon's Ballon d'Or picks of the past three years were Rodri, Dembele and Kane.
Three Barcelona players (Yamal, Raphinha, Pedri) are in the top 10.
recent_news.verification_note: Opinion ranking by one writer; joke about it as 'one list'.

recent_news.headline: Spain lose 2-3 at home to England and finish second in their Nations League group
facts: At the Metropolitano in Madrid: Oyarzabal (pen) and Nico Williams scored for Spain; Kane (pen), Konsa and White for England.
Spain ended on 15 points, level with England but behind on goal difference, so they face France in the quarter-finals.
Barcelona's international diary does not mention Rodri for the 12 Nov win in Prague (2-0) or this game, so his role is unknown.

recent_news.headline: Nations League quarter-final draw: Spain vs France in March 2027
facts: First legs 25-27 March, second legs 28-30 March 2027, with the Finals on 9-13 June 2027.
Barcelona's site notes the Spain v France tie includes Jules Kounde on the French side.
Barcelona host Villarreal on Sunday 22 Nov (14:00 CET, La Liga matchday 13).
recent_news.verification_note: Club news page dated 20 Nov (draw on Friday 20 Nov); Villarreal match 'this Sunday' 14:00 CET, matchday 13 per club article of 19 Nov. Spain v France confirmed on Wikipedia and club site.

recent_news.headline: Manchester City without Rodri: third in the Premier League under Enzo Maresca
facts: As of 8 Nov, City have 21 points from 10 games, third behind Arsenal (27) and Brighton (22).
Wikipedia lists Enzo Fernandez (GBP 125m from Chelsea) and Elliot Anderson (GBP 116m from Nottingham Forest) as new midfielders.
Maresca replaced Pep Guardiola on 29 Jun 2026; Haaland has about 9 league goals.
recent_news.verification_note: Wikipedia only; the page does not link these signings to Rodri's exit.

now.club: FC Barcelona (since 18 Aug 2026), No. 16, head coach Hansi Flick; defensive midfielder, 190 cm / 90 kg.
now.contract: Four years, to 30 June 2030 (club announcement). Fee reported EUR 60m fixed (ESPN) / EUR 76.5m with add-ons (NYT via Wikipedia).
now.national_team: Captain of Spain and 2026 World Cup winner (1-0 v Argentina after extra time on 19 Jul, Ferran Torres goal). Nations League A: Spain 2nd in Group 3 on 15 points; quarter-final v France in March 2027.
now.season_numbers: Wikipedia (as of 8 Nov): 14 Barcelona appearances, 1 goal (the 17 Oct Betis header). La Liga: Barcelona top with 33 pts after 12 games (as of 8 Nov; 11 wins, 1 loss), Real Madrid 30, Atletico 28. Champions League: 5th after 4 games with 9 pts (as of 4 Nov, Wikipedia).
now.fitness: Right hamstring injury reported by the club on 4 Nov; he missed the 8 Nov game at Atletico (club report names an injured 'Rodr...'). No return date found, and the club news page of 20 Nov has no update on him; whether he plays Villarreal on 22 Nov is a GAP. Treat as sensitive.
now.what_people_say: Flick: 'the perfect player for us'. Mourinho: Madrid made a very good offer but Rodri hesitated. 2026 Ballon d'Or: 4th (726 pts) behind Kane, Mbappe, Yamal. FIFPRO World XI 2026. Not in ESPN's top 10 of November.
now.next: Barcelona v Villarreal, Sunday 22 Nov 2026, 14:00 CET, Spotify Camp Nou (La Liga matchday 13). Villarreal is the club where Rodri made his first-team debut in Dec 2015 (reserves Feb 2015); Villarreal are 8th.
now.former_club_context: Manchester City now coached by Enzo Maresca (appointed 29 Jun 2026 after Guardiola); City 3rd in the Premier League as of 8 Nov.
now.caveat: Guardian, BBC, Reuters, Sky, Transfermarkt and NYT could not be read; items rest on club sites, ESPN and Wikipedia pages that cite them. Adversarial re-check on 20 Nov 2026 re-read the club, ESPN and Wikipedia sources; web search was unavailable in that pass.

quick_context: Rodri won the 2024 Ballon d'Or with Manchester City, the first City player to do so; Wikipedia calls him the first defensive midfielder to win since Lothar Matthaeus in 1990.
He scored the only goal of the 2023 Champions League final against Inter and was named Player of the Tournament at Euro 2024.
In 2026 he captained Spain to the World Cup and won the Golden Ball after completing 747 of 799 passes (93%), a tournament record since 1966 records began.

roast_past.angle: Ballon d'Or winner with no social media: told Joe Hart (BBC podcast, Sept 2024) he skipped it as a child to hang out at the park and in his village.
Used to carry his bike on the train to Villarreal B training; now the Ballon d'Or trophy needs a bigger bag.
Took six years to finish a business degree while already playing for Manchester City; 'business admin' meets a EUR 76m transfer.
Sent off on 23 Sep 2023 against Nottingham Forest for lashing out at Morgan Gibbs-White, and City then lost three games without him.
2022 World Cup: Luis Enrique played the midfielder at centre-back for all four Spain games after he studied Pique and Puyol footage.
Scored the 2023 Champions League final winner and only 2 goals in 33 appearances in 2025-26; goals arrive in rare, big batches.
2026 World Cup: Golden Ball winner with 0 goals and 0 assists in 8 starts; the award for walking and passing (96 km, most of anyone).

roast_now.angle: City reportedly kept saying he was 'not for sale', then sold him to Barcelona on 18 Aug 2026.
Hesitated so long over the move that Real Madrid walked away, per Mourinho (the rival coach). Deliberation as a sport.
First Barcelona goal took 51 days after his debut; he was left out at Elche for 'lack of match rhythm' first.
Two years after winning the Ballon d'Or he finished 4th, behind Kane, Mbappe and his new teammate Yamal.
Under three weeks after 4th place, ESPN's top-10 list for November has three Barcelona players and not Rodri.
City added Enzo Fernandez and Elliot Anderson after his exit and sit 3rd in the Premier League; tease City, not Rodri, and only if confirmed.

praise.angle: 2026 World Cup Golden Ball: captain, started all 8 games, 747 of 799 passes (93%), 101 passes in the final, a 1-0 win over Argentina.
2024 Ballon d'Or: first Manchester City winner, first defensive midfielder since Matthaeus (1990), ahead of Vinicius and Bellingham.
Named in the 2026 FIFPRO World XI by 19,806 professional players.
Flick called him 'the perfect player for us' after the debut; Barcelona top La Liga.
Scored the only goal of the 2023 Champions League final against Inter and won the 2025-26 FA Cup and EFL Cup with City.
Covered 96,233 m at the 2026 World Cup, more than any other player, and led the tournament in touches (910).

no_joke_topics: Injuries of any kind: ACL and meniscus (Sept 2024), 2025-26 hamstring and groin, and the right hamstring injury of Nov 2026.
Health, fitness and 'is he fit for Villarreal' speculation.
Family, partner and relationship (a girlfriend named in Wikipedia's personal-life section).
Religion (he is Roman Catholic and talks about God after finals).
The Euro 2024 'Gibraltar is Spanish' chant and the UEFA ban: political and disciplinary, not for jokes.
Violence at the end of the World Cup final (Argentina's Nahuel Molina struck him; FIFA banned players) and FIFA/US politics at the trophy ceremony.
Doping, legal troubles, war: nothing found about Rodri; do not invent any.
Do not blame him for team results where his involvement is not confirmed (El Clasico 25 Oct, Spain 2-3 England 15 Nov).
